verification_report.summary: The complete preparatory derivation is correct. Independent exterior algebra confirms the determinant contraction, Hodge transpose, signs, conjugations, factors, dimension-two cancellation, and covariant-derivative exclusions. The inverse P mapping, spectral weights, Euler identity, determinant bounds, coercivity, and exact complex concavity square all pass. A sufficient threshold is lambda_1 >= nD(2n/tau)^(n-1); the lower bound is mathcal F >= nD^(-1/n). All 37 deduction checks passed. [STW Sections 2 and 4](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1503.04491) were checked, including pages 26–27 visually. [Full report](/Users/mingchen/Non-Kahler/research/rethlas/verification/results/stw_matrix_structure_01/fullreport.md). No C2 estimate or existence result is asserted.
